title: Central-heating boilers and furnaces.
officialText: Clearance requirements for central-heating boilers and furnaces shall comply with Sections 308.4.1 through 308.4.6. The clearance to these appliances shall not interfere with combustion air, draft hood clearance and relief, and accessibility for servicing.
